failed_astro_preview_behavior: Astro preview adds Content-Encoding: gzip; the browser decompresses before the existing explicit DecompressionStream, causing local-only empty additional county rows.
resolution: Use a bounded static HTTP server matching actual raw compressed Pages delivery. No application or frozen source change.
qualification: The live compressed wrapper belongs to the previous deployed build; do not require new and old gzip wrappers to be byte-identical. Their entire decoded JSON is compared. The exact new deployment requires its own original artifact and public byte proof.
